title: Bellman attribute definition
description: One attributes/{name}.jsonc file describing an attribute that can be assigned to roadmap entities.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor support.

name.description: Attribute name in lowercase kebab-case. Must equal the file name without .jsonc.

version.description: Contract version x.y. Increment y for compatible changes; increment x and reset y for breaking ones.

description.description: One-line explanation for readers of the file.

applies_to.description: Entity kinds that may carry this attribute.

required.description: When true, every entity whose kind is in applies_to must be assigned this attribute.

values.description: Legal values: a list of tokens (plain set) or an object keyed by token (keyed metadata).

value_schema.description: JSON Schema for each keyed entry under values, or for open assignment values when values is omitted.

assignment_schema.description: JSON Schema for the bracketed data written on an assignment.

token.description: Value or key: a letter or digit first, then letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.
